name: Las Piedras (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, green and blue charged at the centre with a yellow Taíno sun.
history: Las Piedras is a town and municipality in east Puerto Rico located in the central eastern region of the island, north of Yabucoa; south of Canóvanas and Río Grande; east of Juncos and San Lorenzo; and west of Naguabo and Humacao.
